title: Isle Run
summary: A co-op action run on the three runtime's scenic-3d profile: knights clear three floating isles of skeletons, then beat the Bone Sorcerer.

verified.result: PASS gates 6/6, measures 21/21 (9, the contact sheet, not run: its tool is not in this checkout). The run before it failed measure 5 once (soft step "a background host does not stop the world": not reached, the round had ended under the gate's random input); --check 5 alone and the full verify after it passed
verified.how: node bin/gamesfun.mjs create <dir> --from isle-run, then node builder/tools/verify.mjs <dir> (a build verify, every build measure; 180 s) under gpu-run.sh on Linux with a desktop GPU (CHROME_ARGS="--use-gl=angle --use-angle=gl-egl"); the verdict is builder/gates/verdict.schema.json's and valid against it
